note: Strategic-stockpile status per material. Curated + web-verified; China SRB holdings are secret, so this measures the PUBLIC Western/allied buffer, which is the honest gap.

regimes.fact: ~$1.0-1.4bn held vs a ~$14.8-15.5bn identified shortfall across 88 materials — covers ~6% of the net shortfall.
regimes.verdict: Largely depleted since the Cold War; most critical materials not held.

regimes.fact: Stockpiles 7 rare metals (incl. cobalt, tungsten, manganese, vanadium, nickel) at ~60 days of consumption; target up to 180 days for high-risk.
regimes.verdict: The model — a deliberate buffer built after the 2010 rare-earth shock.

regimes.fact: Holds rare earths, cobalt and others — levels undisclosed.
regimes.verdict: Real but opaque: an information asymmetry as much as a material one.

regimes.fact: A strategic reserve is proposed under the Critical Raw Materials Act.
